styles.sprite: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI game sprite for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector, NOT cartoon. Semi-realistic detailed surfaces, specular highlights, ambient occlusion and soft cinematic lighting from the top-left. Strict top-down view seen from directly above, centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no frame, single object only.
styles.ship: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI game sprite for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector. Glossy metallic hull, specular highlights, soft cinematic lighting from the top-left, glowing emissive lights. Strict top-down view seen from directly above, the front of the craft pointing to the RIGHT side of the image, centered, filling about 70% of the canvas, fully transparent background, no shadow, no text, single object only.
styles.fx: High-quality game visual effect element for a sci-fi space shooter, painterly realistic, seen from directly above, centered, radially symmetric-ish, fully transparent background, no text, no frame, single element only.
styles.icon: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI inventory icon for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector. Glossy metal and glowing energy, soft studio lighting, three-quarter view, single centered object filling about 75% of the canvas, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 48 pixels, fully transparent background, no text, no numbers, no frame.
styles.background: Wide cinematic sci-fi background illustration for the main menu of a browser MMO space shooter, painterly realistic, dark and moody with low contrast in the center so that UI panels on top stay readable, no text, no logos, no UI, no people.
